title: HC cheatsheet: loop choreography + debrief playbook (Riley)
body:
Purpose:
- Quick personal cheat sheet for the upcoming headcount sync + interviewer debriefs.
- Lightweight playbook to run cleaner loops, reduce bias in debriefs, and accelerate decisioning.

High-level agenda (30-45m) for HC sync with hiring managers / EMs:
- 0-5m: Quick status snapshot (open reqs, offers out, pending start dates)
- 5-15m: Priorities this week (who needs interviews, who needs feedback, any blockers)
- 15-30m: Risk & contingency (backfills, freeze triggers, reprioritization)
- 30-40m: Action items and owners (clear next steps + deadlines)

Interviewer loop choreography (template to paste into calendar invite):
- Loop structure (recommended for IC/eng roles):
  - 10m: Recruiting screen (phone) - recruiter notes candidate fit and logistics
  - 30m: Technical deep dive (engineer) - focus on system design / coding exercise
  - 25m: Team fit / collaboration (peer) - collaboration examples and tradeoffs
  - 20m: Manager interview - scope, ownership, growth profile
  - 15m: Debrief buffer / recruiter follow-up
- Interviewer prep notes (copy into each invite):
  - One-sentence goal for this interview (skill signal we own)
  - Top 2 questions to run if short on time
  - Concrete examples to probe (past projects, code samples, shipping decisions)

Rapid red-flag checklist (call out early during loop):
- Inconsistent stories about recent projects or role
- Avoids concrete metrics or ownership statements
- Unable to explain tradeoffs in decisions; vague on impact
- Attitude fit concerns (team collaboration / receptivity to feedback)

Debrief playbook (use at least these four headings in notes):
- Signal summary (3 bullet sentences): quick summary of strongest signals for hire or no-hire
- Top strengths (3): what to lean on in offer conversations
- Biggest unknowns/risks (3): things we need to validate if moving forward
- Recommendation + rationale: hire / proceed to on-site / no-hire + 2-sentence justification

Score normalization guidance (to paste in debrief chat):
- Use 1-5 scale where 3 = meets bar, 4 = exceeds, 2 = below bar, 1 = clear no-hire
- Anchor examples: 3 = shipped a feature end-to-end with impact; 4 = shipped multiple cross-team features or has tangible leadership; 2 = limited ownership, gaps in fundamentals
- Ask: "What would this person need to show in 3 months to be successful?" if unsure

Calibration notes for managers (short):
- Avoid over-indexing on interview performance alone; weigh ramp potential and past outputs
- Prefer consensus: if 2+ interviewers surface the same concern, treat as high priority to resolve

Headcount scenarios (one-pagers for quick thinking):
- Base plan (green): hire as planned, focus on critical product/infra roles, keep top-of-funnel active
  - Priorities: senior infra Eng, 2x L4-L5 product engineers, 1 TPM
  - Timeline: offers out within 2 weeks for prioritized reqs
- Accelerate plan (green+): if quota/budget allows, move up mid-Q hires, prioritize onboarding mentors first
  - Priorities: slowest-ramping roles (data infra), bring an extra recruiter for ramp
- Conservative / freeze (amber): hiring pause for non-critical roles, maintain candidate pipeline for immediate reactivation
  - Priorities: keep 1-2 critical reqs open (security, SRE), convert contractors to temp coverage where possible

Decision hygiene & follow-ups (use in syncs):
- Owner for every ask (name + exact due date)
- For candidate no decisions: list which data points are missing and who will collect them
- For offers: who will own compensation/negotiation and timeline to close

Templates to cut & paste during debriefs:
- "Signal summary: [1-2 lines]. Top strengths: [bullets]. Key concerns: [bullets]. Recommendation: [hire / hold / no-hire]."
- Quick action ask: "Recruiter: schedule reference checks by <date>. Hiring manager: provide take-home assignment feedback by <date>."

Notes-to-self before 1:1 with EMs:
- Ask about headcount flex: any budget re-allocations or unspent contractor spend we can convert?
- Confirm ramp capacity: who can mentor new hires first 6 weeks?
- Any upcoming exec asks that would change hiring priorities? (compliance, partnerships, new region)

Open questions I need answered (to chase post-sync):
- Legal/KMS requirements for private-deploy candidates (security screening timeline?) -> Recruiter to confirm with Security
- Remaining budget for Dedicated cluster ops hires this quarter -> Finance to confirm by Fri
- Potential internal transfers we're overlooking (any teams with bench capacity?) -> EMs to flag

Post-meeting action items (example):
- AMELIE: post prioritized req list in the HC thread (due 2025-03-04)
- JONAS: reach out to candidate X for fast-track interview (due 2025-03-03)
- RILEY: assemble offer comp ranges and approval flow (due 2025-03-05)

Quick checklist before sending out invites / debriefs:
- Interview packet attached (role rubric, scorecard, candidate resume)
- Slack debrief channel pre-created + link in calendar invite
- Recruiter/timekeeper set and named in invite

Random micro-notes (personal):
- Keep debriefs <24h after final loop where possible
- If hiring manager request is vague, scope a 15m scoping session first
- Build a "swing" interview list of 4 people who can step in on short notice

End of doc.

(Probably overstuffed but good to carve out into two short handouts later.)
